votes.section: REPEAL TITLE 3, CHAPTER 10 AND ENACT TITLE 3, CHAPTER 11 OF CITY CODE
votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve the special events ordinance with the proposed amendments, removing the definition of Legacy Events and provisions in 3-10-4(b), instructing staff to bring Legacy Events back to a work meeting for further discussion.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to adjourn.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
